plain: Left to the judgment of an official, not fixed by rule

webster.text: Left to discretion; unrestrained except by discretion or judgment; that is to be directed or managed by discretion only.

example.quote: At first view, by thus joining the word equity with the word law, if we mean any thing, we seem to mean to give the judge a discretionary power.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XV, Jan. 18, 1788
